name: Zeph Sphere
source: A professional skateboarder and influencer that has brought the sport into the mainstream of sports media again. He’s somewhat brash and aggressive but most of it seems to be to protect his girlfriend Kishi. If you can get past his bullheaded nature you’ll find that he’s a cool competitor that can get through even the direst of situations.
